messages:
sophie: Quick postmortem follow-up - converting remediation items into tests. Two-week sprint starting Monday. Need owners for: regression promptset, load replay, and chaos drill.

alex: I can own regression promptset. Will extract failing prompts and write harness in evals. Target Wed EOD.

maria: I'll take load replay. Need infra for ephemeral runner and a CI job. Drafting profile Tue AM. cc @dylan

jordan: I9ll do chaos drill/runbook. Plan small staging canary then ramp. Dry-run next Fri.

dylan: Infra can spin up 2-node ephemeral cluster for replay. Maria send VUs and retention. Example runner: `k6 run --vus 3000 --duration 30m script.js --out influxdb`.

sophie: TL;DR action dates: alex Wed EOD, maria Tue noon, jordan Thu EOD, dylan Wed EOD. I9ll make cards on the postmortem board.

alex: Pass/fail guidance: P95 latency <200ms, error rate <0.5% on replay window. I9ll include bad-case + baseline.

maria: Replay preferred for fidelity; if sanitization blocks us, fallback to synthetic with matching token sizes and session timings.

ops-bot: Card created: "PMT: postmortem -> tests" assigned to sophie - https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/789

jordan: Recommend regression gate: KV-eviction >0.1% or model-fallback >0.5% -> auto-fail rollout + page oncall.

alex: Will add thresholds to gating doc and PR pipeline config.

sophie: Standups Mon/Wed/Fri 11:00 (15m). Two-week retro after sprint. Update cards if anything slips. Ping me for traces or access.
